artworks.title: Christ Walking on the Water
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (The Evans-Tibbs Collection, Gift of Thurlow Evans Tibbs, Jr.)
artworks.description: This print depicts a group of people on a tilting sailboat. The view is slightly elevated, showing the individuals on the boat and the water around them. The horizon is high in the composition, with the low sun on the right side casting a pale glow on the gray scene. The sail is near the top left corner of the print, with several long ropes connecting it to the small boat. Several people appear to be clustered together in the back of the boat, but they are not depicted in detail. One person is near the front of the boat, their back to us, looking out towards the sun. On the far right, the shadowy silhouette of a person is visible on the waves.

artworks.title: Philantrope anglais dans l'exercice ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a conflict involving two figures and a horse pulling a cart. The image depicts a moment of altercation where an individual in a top hat and long coat is grabbing a whip from another figure, who is also holding a whip and appears to be restraining the horse. The style is characterized by stark lines and a caricature-like quality, emphasizing the dynamic interplay between the figures. The horse is harnessed to a cart laden with cargo. Surrounding architecture and cobblestone suggest an urban setting. The drawing conveys a sense of tension and social commentary.

artworks.title: Je compte sur vous pour signer
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a social interaction scene with text. In the image, two individuals sit conversing with each other. One person appears to be holding a document or book. They are seated on a bench in a lightly sketched interior space. Two figures are depicted walking away towards a partially open door on the right side. The background contains text cues possibly from a newspaper or a publication. The drawing uses cross-hatching and fine lines for shading in a mid-19th-century illustrative style.

artworks.title: Manière ingénieuse de décharger les toites ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in a snowy city scene. In the center, a person in a long coat and top hat looks surprised. To the right, a woman in a dress and head covering leans forward under falling snow. On the far right, another individual in similar attire walks away. The background shows snowy buildings and falling snowflakes, suggesting a winter setting on a slick city street.

artworks.title: Danger de secouer trop fortement ... Un prunier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person hanging from a branch of a plum tree, with their top hat falling off. Another person is below, surrounded by hats. The background shows rolling hills and a lightly clouded sky. The style is satirical and caricature-like with exaggerated facial expressions. There is text in French at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Malheureux enfant! ... Ca t'appendra a faire ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in the foreground, one facing slightly to the left, while a female figure emerges from the right with one arm raised. The central character, an older man with short hair and a full beard, is wearing formal attire. The accompanying figure seems to be a child with straight hair. Both are surrounded by water, possibly indicating a flood or a wet environment. The man is holding a duck. In the background, there is a woman with long flowing hair and a loose gown, standing on higher ground or a hill with both arms raised. Ducks are seen swimming or wading through the water around them. The setting suggests a rural scene, with a farmhouse in the distance and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: In convénient de se batir une maison de campagne ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man holding an umbrella in a flooded landscape. The man is standing on a small elevated patch of land, surrounded by water. He is elegantly dressed, complete with a hat, and holding a closed umbrella, gazing at the scene ahead. In the distance, there are submerged fields and partially flooded houses, while bare trees rise from the water. The style is monochrome with precise lines, adding to the atmosphere of the landscape. The text at the bottom comments on the inconvenience of building a country house on a floodplain near a river.

artworks.title: Jeunes imprudens qui se laiseent emporter ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals having a discussion or argument outdoors. The scene features young figures engaged in conversation, with expressions of surprise, frustration, and determination. Some figures are gesturing emphatically. The background includes trees and a building, hinting at an outdoor or street setting. The figures are dressed in period clothing, with some wearing hats. The style resembles caricature or satirical illustrations, highlighting exaggerated facial expressions and animated postures to convey drama and emotion.

artworks.title: Je ne m'étonne plus si celui-la se tentaint tranquille ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three people are partially visible, shown from the waist up. The person on the left is standing and leaning slightly forward with one hand on an open book, wearing glasses and a dark coat over a vest, with wavy hair and a focused expression. The person in the middle is seated and leaning over a desk, with a concentrated facial expression, short hair, and wearing a patterned shirt or vest. The person on the right is seated and hunched over a desk, appearing to write or read, with short hair and wearing similar clothing. An open book and a round object are on the desk. The background is filled with indistinct figures seated at other desks.

artworks.title: Eh! Bien comment me trouves-tu dans mon nouvel uniforme ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man proudly displaying his uniform to an observing woman and child. The drawing is composed of the man in a military uniform, with a hat and epaulets. He stands proudly, hands on hips, exhibiting a confident expression. The woman beside him is dressed in period attire, smiling, while a young child looks up at the man. In the background is a framed portrait of another person in a uniform. The setting appears to be indoors. The artwork is in a 19th-century caricature style, with exaggerated clothing and expressions.

artworks.title: Au nom du ciel, Théodore ne regarde pas ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a rocky area. The first person is a man wearing a top hat, a dark suit with a long coat, and is leaning forward as if climbing. The second person is a woman with a bonnet, a shawl, and a long dress, who is positioned lower and appears to be holding onto the man's coat.

artworks.title: Il parait qu'on vient de revoir le serpent de mer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people from the waist up, seated and facing each other. One person is on the left, leaning towards the right, appearing to speak to the other. They have prominent facial features with distinctive profiles and short, light hair. The other person, on the right, has a surprised expression, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. This person has short hair. Both are dressed in coats and are seated on chairs in a domestic setting. The person on the left is holding a newspaper. Beside them, there is a lamp on a table and a book lying nearby. In the background, there is a wall adorned with a framed portrait of a solemn-faced individual. The room also features a fireplace with a decorative piece placed on the mantel.

artworks.title: Un chapeau ... deux chapeaux ... les malheureux ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man in a top hat observing a hat and clothes on the ground in a field. The scene shows a well-dressed gentleman standing with his hands behind his back, looking at a hat and a pile of clothes in the field. The background includes trees and undulating fields. The drawing features fine shading and line work for texture in the man's clothing and the landscape. The text above and below the image is in French.

artworks.title: Achat d'un tableau horloge
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile with his hands clasped behind his back. He has short dark hair and exaggerated facial features, wearing a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and suspenders holding up his dark-colored trousers. The man is positioned indoors, near a small table with a tablecloth and a painting on the wall. The painting appears to depict a church. The background consists of an interior wall with no other details.

artworks.title: Plus souvent que tu m'attraperas encore à satisfaire ta fantaisie d'aller dîner sur l'herbe . . . V'là deux heures que nous marchons et nous n'avons pas encore trouvé le moindre qazon . . . Si j'avais su, j'aurais fourré au fond du panier notre grand tapis vert.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures carrying baskets in a rural landscape. In the foreground, the two figures are seen from the back, walking with one carrying a larger basket filled with items, and the other holding a smaller bag or basket. The setting suggests a rural scene, with open land, trees, and a simple sky. The drawing uses stippled and lined shading to show texture in the clothing and landscape. The text at the top reads "Les Bons Bourgeois."

artworks.title: Robert ... tu ne soutiens plus la conversation ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in full-body view. The man on the left is squatting with his hands on his knees, facing the other man. He is wearing a tall hat and a long coat over striped pants, with distinct facial features including a prominent nose and deeply lined expressions. The man on the right is sitting on a barrel with his head bent forward, wearing a coat and pants. Both men seem to be engaged in conversation or a situation. A table with a bottle and glasses is on the left, and a fence is in the background on the right. The backdrop is lightly sketched, creating a textured, abstract environment around the figures.

artworks.title: Vous êtes toujours galant! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a man and a woman, standing facing each other in conversation. The man has curly hair and a prominent nose, with a slightly open mouth. He is wearing a long coat and holding a hat in his hand, with an umbrella or cane under his arm. The woman is wearing a bonnet, a shawl or cloak, and is holding a muff. She also appears to have her mouth slightly open. In the background, there is a faint view of buildings or a cityscape.

artworks.title: Vingt sous de denier a Dieu...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of three people. On the left, an older woman stands facing two other figures. Her face is shown in profile, with distinct facial features and she wears a headscarf covering her hair. She is dressed in a long, simple dress and is holding a pair of spectacles in one outstretched hand. On the right, a man and a woman stand close together, with their backs turned mostly towards the viewer. The man is dressed in formal attire, including a long coat and a top hat, while the woman wears a shawl over her head and shoulders. The background depicts a simple architectural setting, featuring the corner of a building or a doorway and cobblestone pavement. The overall scene is grayscale.

artworks.title: Vois comme ils avaient abimè ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up, with their backs turned, standing in a cobblestone street. The person on the left, a man, wears a tall top hat and a dark suit, gesturing with a cane or stick towards a nearby building. His facial features are not visible. To his right, a woman stands, mostly covered by a large patterned shawl, with only the back of her head visible, which appears to be covered by a bonnet. The background features old stone buildings, one of which shows signs of damage or disrepair. There is also a worker in the background, engaged in construction or repair work, scaling a partially destroyed wall.

artworks.title: Je ne pourrai jamais faire croire a ma femme ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing near a canopied bed holding a mirror. The expression on their face appears surprised or shocked. There is another figure reclined under the bed's canopy. The setting includes an ornate bed with draped curtains, decorative patterns on the wall, and a textured floor. The drawing style features fluid lines, shading for depth, and a caricature or satirical quality.

artworks.title: Au restaurant a 32 sous
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a restaurant setting. One person stands on the left while holding a dish, and the other person sits on the right holding a piece of bread. The standing individual wears a dark jacket, a light shirt, and a long apron. The seated individual has curly hair and is dressed in a dark jacket over a shirt. The table in front of the seated person has a tablecloth, a glass, and bottles on it.

artworks.title: Aspect de la Seine de Paris a chatou
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)

artworks.title: Discussion de la constitution
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing close together, seemingly engaged in a discussion. The man on the left has short hair and is wearing a suit. He appears to be gesturing with his hands. The central man is wearing a hat that covers his head, and a coat. The man on the right has longer hair and is wearing a shirt, vest, and coat. Each man has a different facial expression. There is a drawn curtain behind them and a table or shelf to the left with abstract shapes. The setting suggests an indoor environment, possibly a room with wood paneling or wallpaper.

artworks.title: Tiens au milieu de ...bouleversemens ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are seated on a cushioned bench. The man on the left is leaning back with his legs stretched out, while the man on the right is leaning forward with a folded newspaper in his hand. The man on the left has a bald head, a prominent nose, and wears a shirt with a high collar under a dark jacket. The man on the right has wavy hair and distinctive facial features, wearing a similar outfit. A glass sits on the small round table next to the man on the right. The background features patterned wall coverings, possibly depicting draped fabric or wallpaper.
